description: SEBI-registered Asset Management Company managing mutual fund schemes.

FILED.status_explanation: Your complaint regarding mutual fund units, SIP, redemption payout, or folio update has been submitted.
FILED.recommended_action: Note the complaint reference number or service request generated by the AMC/RTA.
suggested_documents: Copy of complaint submitted to AMC/RTA (may be useful for your grievance record)
FILED.official_portal: AMC website / CAMS or KFintech investor portal
FILED.conditions: Initial stage. Intermediary acknowledgement is awaited.
FILED.guidance_notes: AMCs and RTAs (like CAMS / KFintech) log complaints under registered folio numbers.
FILED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

ACKNOWLEDGED.status_explanation: The AMC or its Registrar & Transfer Agent (RTA) has acknowledged your complaint.
ACKNOWLEDGED.recommended_action: Record the ticket reference number and expected turnaround communication.
suggested_documents: AMC/RTA acknowledgement email (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
ACKNOWLEDGED.guidance_notes: RTAs reconcile transaction data with bank payment gateways for redemptions/SIPs.
ACKNOWLEDGED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

AWAITING_RESPONSE.status_explanation: Your grievance is currently awaiting investigation and response from the AMC.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.recommended_action: Keep your Common Account Statement (CAS) and bank statement ready.
suggested_documents: AMC acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) or Folio Statement
Bank statement showing debit/non-credit of funds
AWAITING_RESPONSE.conditions: If the AMC does not respond or resolve the issue within the configured window (e.g. 30-day demo configuration).
AWAITING_RESPONSE.guidance_notes: Investors can escalate mutual fund grievances to SEBI SCORES if the AMC does not resolve the issue.
AWAITING_RESPONSE.disclaimer: Internal warning timestamps and time windows are demo configurations for simulation purposes, not statutory regulatory deadlines.

RESPONSE_RECEIVED.status_explanation: The AMC has provided an official resolution letter or clarification.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.recommended_action: Verify if the units or bank payout have been credited accurately. If dissatisfied, escalate.
suggested_documents: AMC response letter (may be useful for your grievance record)
AMC acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.escalation_path: SEBI SCORES 2.0 or SMART ODR Portal
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.conditions: If the AMC response is unsatisfactory or does not address the claim.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.guidance_notes: Review the NAV date and unit allocation calculations provided in the response.
RESPONSE_RECEIVED.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

RESOLVED.status_explanation: The mutual fund grievance has been resolved.
RESOLVED.recommended_action: Download an updated Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) verifying correct unit holding and bank mandate.
suggested_documents: Resolution confirmation from AMC (may be useful for your personal records)
RESOLVED.escalation_path: None required unless resolution is not honored
RESOLVED.guidance_notes: Keep copies of resolution confirmations for tax filing purposes.

FURTHER_ACTION.status_explanation: The mutual fund grievance is ready for escalation to SEBI SCORES 2.0 or SMART ODR.
FURTHER_ACTION.recommended_action: File your complaint on SEBI SCORES 2.0 citing the AMC name, folio number, and complaint acknowledgement.
suggested_documents: AMC acknowledgement receipt (may be useful for your grievance record)
Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) (may be useful for your grievance record)
Copy of original complaint (may be useful for your grievance record)
AMC response letter if received (may be useful for your grievance record)
Escalation filing receipt from SCORES / SMART ODR once submitted
FURTHER_ACTION.conditions: Response overdue under demo configuration or response rejected by investor.
FURTHER_ACTION.guidance_notes: SEBI SCORES directly routes mutual fund complaints to the AMC compliance team with regulatory tracking.
FURTHER_ACTION.disclaimer: Official regulatory process information. Any simulated time windows are demo configurations for testing.

response_window_exceeded.title: AMC Response Window Exceeded Notice
response_window_exceeded.explanation: FlowGuard detected that the recorded elapsed time exceeds the configured window (e.g. 30-day demo configuration) with no AMC response recorded.
response_window_exceeded.recommended_step: You may prepare to escalate to SEBI SCORES 2.0 or SMART ODR using your folio and complaint ticket.

potential_delay.title: AMC Potential Delay Notice
potential_delay.explanation: Processing is taking longer than configured benchmarks.
potential_delay.recommended_step: Contact the AMC Investor Relations Officer citing your folio and ticket ID.

awaiting_response.title: Awaiting AMC Response
awaiting_response.explanation: Complaint is currently being processed by the AMC / RTA within normal window.
awaiting_response.recommended_step: No action needed. FlowGuard is tracking this stage.
